key.name: panel-gpu-temp
key.summary: Show the GPU temperature in the top bar
key.description: Only while the NVIDIA GPU is awake; it is never woken up just to read it.

key.name: show-history
key.summary: Show the temperature history in the menu

key.name: ac-profile
key.summary: Profile applied when the charger is plugged in (empty = keep the current one)

key.name: battery-profile
key.summary: Profile applied when running on battery (empty = keep the current one)

key.name: show-peripherals
key.description: Controllers, mice and keyboards, wireless battery and the last input; input is only read while the menu is open.

key.name: modes-expanded
key.summary: Modes section expanded in the menu

key.name: peripherals-expanded
key.summary: Peripherals section expanded in the menu

key.name: turbo-key
key.summary: Use the NitroSense key to toggle the Performance profile
